justification: `byte-buddy-dep/src/main/java/net/bytebuddy/description/type/TypeVariableToken.java` is a small, cohesive token class: 3 fields and 10 small public members, all focused on one responsibility (representing/detaching a type variable and exposing its symbol, bounds, annotations, visitor transformation, and value semantics). The companion test `byte-buddy-dep/src/test/java/net/bytebuddy/description/type/TypeVariableTokenTest.java` only covers these same behaviors (`getSymbol`, `getBounds`, `getAnnotations`, `accept`), with no sign of separate concerns or bloated structure.
